import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
credit_fraud = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Set the visual style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a figure and axis
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))

# Create a boxplot to visualize the distribution of transaction amount by transaction type and fraud status
sns.boxplot(data=credit_fraud, x='transaction_type', y='amount', hue='is_fraud')

# Add axis labels and title
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Transaction Amount', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Transaction Amount by Type and Fraud Status', fontsize=14)

# Add legend
plt.legend(title='Is Fraud', loc='upper right')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
